image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate armor displayed on a mannequin or stand. The armor features a polished silver/steel finish with rows of decorative brass or bronze rivets/bosses arranged in curved patterns across the chest and abdomen. The surface is highly reflective, showing distorted reflections of the surrounding environment (likely a museum or shop window). The armor has a distinct anatomical contour with a raised center and curved side edges. A leather strap or attachment point is visible on the left side.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic metal objects or other armor types (e.g., cuirass vs. breastplate).
To analyze the complex reflections and ensure they are physically consistent with a curved metallic surface, checking for AI-generated reflection artifacts.
To ensure the boundaries of the armor against the background are sharp and that the rivets are topologically connected to the plate without melting.
To validate the 3D curvature of the plate and ensure the depth map aligns with the visual cues of a convex/concave metal object.

focus_areas: Reflection consistency on curved metal surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections in the metal. In AI images, reflections on curved surfaces often warp incorrectly or contain nonsensical elements. Verify if the reflected background matches the visible background context. Also, check if the rivets appear 'stamped' into the metal or merely floating on top.
